Dear Mr. Siflinger:
The Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project, Cambridge, Massachusetts, that was submitted to the Department of Agriculture, was referred to the Soil Conservation Service for review and comment.
We have reviewed the statement and have no comments that are relative to our areas of concern. The opportunity to review this statement is appreciated.
Sincerely,
Dr. Benjamin Isgar State Conservationist
